title: Microsoft Copilot: add agents and skills from the plus menu
summary: Pass with minor corrections. Microsoft documents the administrator paths and preview Graph operations; the table notes should identify the apply-once configuration, and the statement that Premium includes agent use needs the qualifications in Microsoft's billing documentation.

claims.claim: This roadmap item concerns Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365).
Microsoft plans to let users insert agents and skills in prompts for specialized tasks.
claims.quote: Users will be able to insert Agents and Skills in prompts for specialized tasks.

claims.claim: The planned route is the plus menu, Add work content, then the Agents and Skills tab.
claims.quote: They can add them from the Agents and Skills tab after selecting 'Add work content' from the plus (+) menu.

claims.claim: Users will also access agents and skills by typing / in their prompt.
claims.quote: Users can also access Agents and Skills by typing / and @ in their prompt.

claims.claim: User access is reached in Microsoft 365 admin center at Agents > Settings > User access.
claims.quote: Select Agents > Settings > User access to manage your organization's agents and plugins.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can set agent User access with the applyOnce resource configuration explained in the prose.
claims.quote: Create a new configurationMonitor object that runs periodically in the background at a scheduled frequency to detect configuration drift in monitorOnly mode, or applies a desired-state baseline once in applyOnce mode.
claims.fix: Keep the call. Add to controls[0].note and the matching table note: 'Set mode to applyOnce; baseline.resources uses resourceType microsoft.agent.useraccess, resourceVersion 1, and properties.valueObject.userAssignmentCategory set to everyone or noOne.' The body already gives this configuration; the row currently gives values without naming the property.

claims.claim: Publisher access is reached in Microsoft 365 admin center at Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, go to Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can set allowed publisher types with the applyOnce resource configuration explained in the prose.
claims.quote: An active applyOnce monitor runs in the background on behalf of the signed-in administrator and then becomes inactive. Its result reports the outcome of the run.
claims.fix: Keep the call and existing publisher property names. Add to controls[1].note and the matching table note: 'Set mode to applyOnce; baseline.resources uses resourceType microsoft.agent.allowedagenttypes, resourceVersion 1, and these properties inside properties.valueObject.' This carries the deciding mode from the existing prose into the row; the reference defaults mode to monitorOnly.

claims.claim: No separate UI or API switch for the Agents and Skills plus-menu entry is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "plus menu" Graph PowerShell disable skills; "Copilot" "Agents and Skills" "menu" "control". Read Agent settings, connector availability, TCM Agent resources and Build skills; found general controls but no separate entry-point switch.

claims.claim: The existing User access setting offers All users, which is its default.
claims.quote: All users - This option is the default. It means that all users in the organization can access agents and plugins, subject to the existing app policies and user assignments.

claims.claim: User access offers No users to deny organization-wide access to agents and plugins.
claims.quote: No users - This option means that no users in the organization can access agents and plugins.

claims.claim: User access offers Specific users or groups to restrict the permitted population.
claims.quote: Specific users or groups - This option lets you select specific users or groups in your organization to have access to agents and plugins.
